fact: A Banco de Cabo Verde official says the BCV handles complaints about digital payment systems, though often cannot resolve them where the user caused the failure.

The Banco de Cabo Verde's 2024 conduct supervision report says banks refunded clients for unauthorised card and internet-banking transactions under Decree-Law 8/2018, the legal regime for payment services and electronic money.

The Banco de Cabo Verde recorded 10 complaints about internet banking among 169 banking complaints in 2024, and banks refunded complainants 3.25 million escudos, mainly for unauthorised card and internet-banking transactions.
